BrochureContent.Content:
An exceptionally well presented 4 bed detached bungalow, this impressive residence comes to the market in true turnkey condition, having been beautifully maintained and tastefully decorated throughout. Occupying a generous site in the highly sought after area of Jenkinstown, the property enjoys a peaceful setting while benefiting from a superbly convenient location just a short distance from Kilkenny City and an excellent range of amenities. Offering spacious, light-filled accommodation and attractive outdoor spaces, this is a welcoming home ready for its next owners to simply move in and enjoy.

Location
Ideally positioned on the sought after Tower Road in Jenkinstown, this impressive family home enjoys the perfect balance of peaceful countryside living with exceptional convenience. The property is located just minutes from Kilkenny City and benefits from excellent connectivity to the N77 Kilkenny to Castlecomer Road, with the M9 Motorway accessible in approximately 15 minutes, providing links to Carlow, Waterford and Dublin. Whether commuting for work or travelling further afield, this location offers outstanding accessibility while retaining a tranquil residential setting.
A wealth of recreational amenities are close at hand. Jenkinstown Woodland is approximately a 10 minute walk from the property and offers scenic woodland walking trails. Dunmore Countryside Park is just a 6 minute drive away and provides additional outdoor amenities including walking trails, children's playgrounds, picnic areas and a ball wall. Conahy GAA is a stone's throw away and is host to regular community events. Kilkenny City is an 8 minute drive and offers an excellent range of primary and secondary schools, supermarkets, cafés, restaurants, healthcare facilities, sporting clubs and retail outlets. Castlecomer is approximately a 12 minute drive and is home to the popular Castlecomer Discovery Park, offering a wide range of outdoor pursuits and family activities.

Description
This beautifully presented detached bungalow is a turnkey home, finished and maintained to a very high standard throughout. Tastefully decorated with a warm and contemporary interior, the property offers bright, spacious accommodation that has been thoughtfully designed for modern family living. Every room reflects the care and attention invested by the current owners, creating a welcoming home that is ready for immediate occupation.
The generous accommodation is complemented by attractive, well maintained gardens and outdoor spaces. A sun drenched south west facing patio provides the perfect setting for outdoor dining and entertaining, while the mature hedging surrounding the site offers excellent privacy and a wonderful sense of seclusion. The spacious tarmac driveway provides ample off-street parking, and the substantial detached garage, complete with power, plumbing and a floored attic accessed via a Stira staircase, offers exceptional storage, workshop or hobby space.
This outstanding property will appeal to a wide range of purchasers, particularly those seeking a stylish, move-in-ready family home in a peaceful yet highly convenient location.

A south west facing patio is accessed directly from the kitchen/dining area, creating an ideal outdoor entertaining space that enjoys excellent sunshine throughout the day. Set on a generous site, the property is surrounded by mature hedging, ensuring a high level of privacy. The driveway is fully tarmacadamed and accessed through electric gates, with ample parking space, while the peaceful setting combines the best of countryside living with the convenience of nearby schools, recreational amenities, Kilkenny City and everyday services.

Summary
This exceptional detached residence offers a rare opportunity to acquire a beautifully finished turnkey home in one of Kilkenny's most desirable residential settings. Combining spacious, light filled accommodation with superb outdoor space, excellent privacy and an enviable location close to Kilkenny City and the N77 and M9 road networks, this property is ideally suited to families, professionals and those looking for a home that is ready to walk straight into. Early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate everything this outstanding home has to offer.
